text:
Introduction
This document outlines the maintenance inspection 
on 3 Ph, Turbo Alternator which must be performed monthly bases as indicated 
by M1 in the title block, 
This procedure was applied in 
Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976,The generator data: 81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, 
PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection .
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.Samir 
Ouf Hassoub , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be 
 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety 
 category.
Safety fence (rope) 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear safety helmet, 
 shoes, gloves ... etc.
Gas turbine out of 
 service at cold state.
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete tool set
Safety helmet safety 
 shoes, breathing mask safety glass... etc
New brushes
Digital voltmeter, and 
 clamp ammeter
Work to be carried out
Seal Oil Supply System
Check oil filters and cleaning if required .
Coolers
Check vents .
Hydrogen System
Check gas consumption .
Inspect dry type filters and cleaning if 
 required .
Exciter Set
Inspect air filters and clearing if 
 required .
Inspect brushes .
Hydrogen System
Check gas drier and clearing if required .
Check thermal 
 gas analyzer
Inspect brains 
 at oil vapour exfractor and pressure pipes
Inspect bearing 
 insulation
Inspect oil vapour extractor fan
